provenance.build: cargo build --release --locked --example cpu_benchmark; default features, no profiling
provenance.timing_scope: Complete owned OCR on predecoded BGR24; excludes decode, capture, model loading and compilation; no alignment capture
provenance.worker_contract: Internal Rust-only _worker with two copied manifests differing only in direction_classification. Diagnostic A/B, not baseline qualification. The worker imports cls.onnx in both modes, outside inference timing; disabled builder skips classifier compilation/execution.
provenance.recognition_scheduling: line_workers=0; static CpuBudgets prints four owners/two base kernel threads. Current for_recognition_units dynamically selects eight owners/one kernel thread on this AVX2/FMA host when there are at least eight independent units. Sparse keeps the four-owner base; dense and mixed select eight.

validation.within_mode_complete_owned_results_equal: Each warm-up and all three measured results equal the separately recorded first-inference result, checked by cpu_benchmark _worker.

limitations: Three corpus fixtures, not a screen-capture workload or full accuracy corpus.
Tiny model only; one Windows AVX2/FMA physical host; eight logical CPUs with affinity 0xff.
Three measured calls per mode/input give observed ranges, not statistical confidence intervals.
Sparse timing ranges overlap; its 2.6% median reduction is inconclusive.
Removing orientation changes all three sparse text lines and one mixed line; no accuracy ground-truth assessment was performed.
This is complete owned OCR latency, not separately instrumented classification time.
Screen capture, image decoding and model initialization are excluded; worker imports classifier weights even in disabled mode.
No C# qualification or comparison with older source revisions; production defaults unchanged.
